title: Turkish Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Turkish-inspired lamb stew, adapted for a keto diet.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Return the lamb cubes to the pot and season with salt and black pepper.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
Serve with a side of cauliflower rice or a low-carb vegetable for a complete meal.
